## What's new
- **PC Details timing log.** Every time PC Details loads, the app appends a step-by-step timing log to `%AppData%\HelpDeskProTools\Logs\pc-details.log`. It lists each section, every WMI connection and query inside it, registry and AD lookups, how long each section waited on shared data, and the moment each card appeared (with the section it was last waiting on). The five slowest steps are summarized at the end of each load. Use it to find what is holding up a slow card. Hover the "Loaded in" time in the PC Details header to see the log's path.
- The log is moved to `pc-details.old.log` once it passes 2 MB, so it never grows without limit.

## Upgrading from v5.1.4
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.1.5-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.

## Requirements
- Windows 10/11 x64, domain-joined
- RSAT Active Directory tools (for AD Console)
- PowerShell 7 recommended for Remote PS and SFC Scan (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is used as a fallback)
- Target PCs: WinRM, the `c$` admin share and WMI/RPC reachable; `AllowRemoteRPC = 1` for Send Message
